title: BUGFIX — /record warns on missing TikTok URL; /deliver shows URL in prompt (gate views stuck at 0)
rationale: 16 posts recorded in manual-posts.jsonl but 0 with tiktok_url, 0 total views. Gate requires 500 views by Apr 7. Operator runs /record <id> 0 (without URL) because /deliver only shows /record <id> 0 in its prompts. Fix: (1) cmdRecord warns when no URL provided and reminds how to update; (2) cmd-delivery.ts updates key /record prompts to include URL placeholder. Views gate can only be met if URLs are captured.

tasks.description: In scripts/telegram-commands/cmd-content.ts cmdRecord(): when tiktokUrl is undefined, append a warning to the success message: '\n\n⚠️ No TikTok URL — views won\'t be tracked. Update later: `/record <id> <views> https://tiktok.com/@you/video/...`'
In scripts/telegram-commands/cmd-delivery.ts: update the 3-4 main /record prompts from `/record <id> 0` to `/record <id> 0 <tiktok_url>` to remind operator that URL is needed.
